args.code:
import pandas as pd, re
def d(v):
    v=(v or '').strip()
    m=re.match(r'^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$',v)
    return f"{m.group(2)}/{m.group(3)}/{m.group(1)}" if m else v
def n(v):
    v=(v or '').strip().replace(' ','').replace(' ','')
    return v.replace(',','.')
def run(ctx):
    df=ctx.read_csv('purchase_orders_export_2026-10.csv')
    o=pd.DataFrame()
    o['po_number']=df['PO No.']; o['line']=df['Ln']; o['part_number']=df['Item']; o['supplier_id']=df['Vendor']
    o['qty']=df['Order Qty'].map(n); o['uom']=df['UoM']; o['unit_price']=df['Unit Price'].map(n); o['currency']=df['Curr']
    o['order_date']=df['Order Date'].map(d); o['promised_date']=df['Promise Date'].map(d); o['received_date']=df['Received'].map(d)
    o['qty_received']=df['Qty Rcvd'].map(n); o['status']=df['Status']; o['buyer']=df['Buyer Code']
    ctx.t['normalised']=o
